boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Slippery Rock University of Pennsylvania
boards.description: Ten named, under-21-safe destinations with published evening or overnight availability in and around Slippery Rock.

cards.title: Aebersold Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: SRU campus
cards.notes: Use the ARC for an evening workout Monday through Thursday; check SRU’s posted schedule before heading over because breaks can change access.
cards.short_summary: Campus recreation remains open into the evening on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists spring-semester ARC hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Spring-semester hours: Monday–Thursday, 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; hours are modified during breaks and finals.

cards.title: ARC Rock Wall
cards.subtitle: Inside Aebersold Recreation Center, SRU campus
cards.notes: Plan a climbing session during the posted weekday window, then verify any break or finals adjustment on the ARC hours page.
cards.short_summary: A named campus climbing facility with evening weekday access.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists Rock Wall hours as 3–9 p.m. Monday through Friday, with bouldering available during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Rock Wall hours are 3–9 p.m. Monday–Friday; posted schedule notes modified hours during breaks and finals.

cards.title: ARC Pool
cards.subtitle: Inside Aebersold Recreation Center, SRU campus
cards.notes: For a later swim, arrive before the listed pool closing buffer and confirm the academic-term schedule rather than relying on break hours.
cards.short_summary: The campus pool has evening hours during spring and fall terms.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU lists spring and fall pool hours through 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday, with the pool closing 30 minutes before the building.
cards.access_notes: Spring/fall pool hours: Monday–Thursday, 6 a.m.–9 p.m.; the pool closes 30 minutes before the building.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Grove City Road
cards.subtitle: 219 Grove City Road, Slippery Rock
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru, dine-in, or delivery option when you need a food stop after campus evening activities; confirm availability before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Slippery Rock food stop with published 1 a.m. daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. every day for 219 Grove City Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 219 Grove City Road, Slippery Rock
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours of 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily and identifies dine-in, delivery, and drive-thru service.

cards.title: Subway at Love's Travel Stop #731
cards.subtitle: 1011 New Castle Road, Slippery Rock
cards.notes: Use this sandwich counter for an evening pickup; the official store page provides both the address and the daily closing time.
cards.short_summary: A named Slippery Rock Subway location open through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official page lists this Love’s Travel Stop #731 location as open 6 a.m.–11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Subway at 1011 New Castle Road, Slippery Rock
cards.access_notes: Official store hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Love's Travel Stop #731
cards.subtitle: 1011 New Castle Road, Slippery Rock
cards.notes: Use the travel-stop stopover for its overnight setting; the co-located Subway page identifies the location and lists an Open 24 Hours service.
cards.short_summary: A named travel-stop destination with published 24-hour service.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official page identifies Love’s Travel Stop #731 at 1011 New Castle Road and lists “Open 24 Hours” among its services.
cards.source_title: Subway at Love's Travel Stop #731, Slippery Rock
cards.access_notes: The official page identifies this as Love’s Travel Stop #731 and lists an “Open 24 Hours” service; Subway counter hours are separately listed as 6 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Sheetz in Slippery Rock
cards.subtitle: Slippery Rock, PA
cards.notes: Treat this as an overnight convenience stop and use the store’s food and retail areas responsibly; verify any service-specific limitations on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A Slippery Rock Sheetz backed by the company’s 24/7 operating policy.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz identifies a Slippery Rock store and states that all Sheetz convenience stores are open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
cards.source_title: Joe Sheetz Named to Convenience Store News Hall of Fame | Sheetz
cards.access_notes: Sheetz states all of its convenience stores are open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year; a current Sheetz job page identifies a Slippery Rock location.

cards.title: Fox's Pizza Den
cards.subtitle: 662 Centreville Pike, Slippery Rock
cards.notes: For a later pizza, hoagie, or stromboli pickup, aim for Friday or Saturday and use the official store page to reconfirm hours.
cards.short_summary: A named local pizza location open until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Fox’s official Slippery Rock page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Friday and Saturday until 10 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday closing time is 9 p.m.

cards.title: Katana Asian Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 223 Grove City Road, Suite 6, Slippery Rock
cards.notes: Choose this for a sit-down or takeout dinner before 10 p.m.; the restaurant’s direction page posts the same dinner closing time all week.
cards.short_summary: A named Slippery Rock dinner destination open until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Katana Asian Cuisine lists dinner hours until 10 p.m. Monday through Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Katana Asian Cuisine — Directions and Hours
cards.access_notes: Official dinner hours: Monday–Saturday, 3:30–10 p.m.; Sunday, noon–10 p.m.

cards.title: Boozel Express
cards.subtitle: SRU campus
cards.notes: Use this named campus dining location only after confirming the live dining schedule, since SRU directs students to its dining site for current hours.
cards.short_summary: A campus food-access point SRU announced would offer 24/7 access.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU’s dining-vendor announcement states that Boozel Express would return with 24/7 access.
cards.source_title: SRU partners with new food vendor, introduces new meal plan prices
cards.access_notes: SRU’s published announcement says Boozel Express would offer 24/7 access; confirm current term operations through SRU Dining before going.

warnings: Boozel Express’s 24/7 statement is from SRU’s 2021 announcement; its access notes explicitly direct users to confirm the current term schedule.
